ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Mars

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.
